text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday the 177.05 billion lei three-month treasury bill issue, covering part of the 1996 budget deficit, was oversubscribed with bids exceeding the offer by 6.95 billion.
The T-bills, maturing on January 16, 1997, were offered with a coupon giving an annual yield of 50.23 percent.

Seven banks -- Banca de Credit Cooperatist Bankcoop SA, Banca Comerciala Romana SA, Banca Romana de Comert Exterior SA, Banc Post SA, Exim Bank SA Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA and the Bucharest branch of ING Bank -- and their clients bought the Finance Ministry's papers.
The Finance Ministry accepted all bids, the BNR said.
A public subscription for fresh bills is also scheduled on Friday when some 600 billion lei will be on offer.
Results of subscriptions will be available on BNR01. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
